title: MEIKO — A Clever Idea〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's waiting in their seats with eager anticipation.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I hope they enjoy our fun card show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm sure they will! I mean, we practiced a ton for this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. And with Tsukasa's help, the script turned out splendidly. All that's left is for us to give it everything we have.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right! Let's do our best to make our show an instant classic!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
“Hm...? Wait, where am I?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Yes, it's done!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Thank goodness I was able to finish it before they moved away.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “I hope this helps them understand how I feel...”
“That's strange... For some reason, I know that she's thinking, 'Even though you're moving far away, I hope we still get to be friends'...”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line:
“Ah, I see...
I must have been born from that overflowing emotion, written down in this card.”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Don't worry. I promise to deliver your thoughts to your friend!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Let's see... Their house is just down this street... Whoa... Oh no!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “The wind's taking away my card! Wait, come back!”
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Naughty wind! Let me down right this second!”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “No, I'm going to fall into the river! I'll get all wet!”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “Huh? What's that in the air? Got it!”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “What is this? A piece of paper...?”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Th-Thank goodness...! You're a lifesaver...!”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “Wait, you can talk?!”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “I'm sorry if I startled you. I'm a card fairy, and I was born to deliver this message to its rightful recipient!”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “So, I know this is asking a lot of you, but would you be willing to do me a big favor?”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
“Huff... Huff... Huff...
This is where you said you got separated from that girl, but I'm not seeing anyone...”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Where could she have gone? Maybe she went over to her friend's house...”
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Young Man
rows.Line:
“What's wrong, son?
You look in quite the hurry.”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “Oh, I was just helping this fairy get to where she needs to go. But I'm so tired after running all the way here...”

rows.Speaker: Young Man
rows.Line: “I see. In that case, would you like me to give you a ride on my motorcycle?”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “You'd do that? Thank you very much...!”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“I see...
And you say the girl who wrote this card may pass by my house?”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Yes, so if you could please let us wait here...!”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“Of course, dear.
I'm sure you're tired, so please feel free to take a rest.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “Oh, also... Would you mind lending me your card while you wait?”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “Okay, there we are. The edges looked a little crinkled, so I fixed them using masking tape.”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Thank you very much! This floral pattern is so lovely. I'm sure that girl's going to love what you did.”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Oh, someone's walking this way. Could it be...?”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Yes, it's her! Over here!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Thank goodness I was able to find my card...!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “And I was so surprised when I found out that my feelings produced a fairy.”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line:
“A lot happened after I got blown away...
But I'm glad to be back in your hands now!”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “So, let's go deliver your message to your friend!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “But... I'm sure they'll be all gone by the time we get there...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “So, it's okay. We don't have to...”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “No, you can't give up.”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line:
“I mean, you looked so hard for me...
That means you want your friend to read this message, right?”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “I exist because your thoughts and feelings were so strong. So...”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “Please...! Let me deliver your message! Let me deliver your feelings to them!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Ms. Fairy...”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “Yeah, it might be too soon to give up.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “You might still be able to catch them if you cut through my backyard.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Thank you both so much!
I want to see this through to the end!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Huff... Huff... Huff... Here we are!
I really hope we made it in time...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “No, the car...!”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line: “What?! But we were so close...!”
“Alright, I think that's our cue!”

rows.Speaker: Wind Fairy A
rows.Line:
“Nice to meet you. We're wind fairies!
Sorry if this bunch caused you some trouble earlier.”

rows.Speaker: Wind Fairy B
rows.Line: “We're sorry. We were just playing.”

rows.Speaker: Wind Fairy C
rows.Line: “Let us help deliver your card to make up for what happened.”

rows.Speaker: Wind Fairies
rows.Line: “We'll huff! And puff! And blow it away!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Oh, my card's flying away...!”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line:
“Haha! That's incredible!
It's sure to get delivered now!”

rows.Speaker: Wind Fairy A
rows.Line: “Hehe. We can move faster than a car if we really put our minds to it! So, let's fly!”

rows.Speaker: Card Fairy
rows.Line:
“Leave the rest to me!
I promise to deliver your message to your friend!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Thank you! Good luck, everyone...!”
After the show

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Congratulations, everyone.
That was an excellent performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My jaw hit the floor when I saw that you guys turned the cards we made together into a whole show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We were able to put on this wonderful show because you did such a good job of teaching us, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was surprised when I heard that a card would be the protagonist, but it ended up being such a heartwarming story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, the scene where she flies off to get delivered. The gust effect you used made it feel all the more real.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much!
Especially you, Tsukasa. This wouldn't have been possible without you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for allowing me to help with the script. You made it such an excellent show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Woohoo! We really did it♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm so glad!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There really is nothing more fun than doing shows together like this!
